verdict.rationale: IRS online services are a transactional filing and payment platform, so event-triggered automation is a fair question for this kind of product. The pack documents no user-definable rules, triggers or event-driven actions. The machine channels it does document, MeF XML transmission and IRIS A2A, are credentialed submission rails, not automation rule engines. No public API or OpenAPI spec was found, and online account access sits behind an ID.me biometric check.
